data.one_liner: Multi-purpose immutable DateTime subclass supporting multiple localizations and duration formatting.
data.what_it_does: Provides an immutable DateTime subclass inspired by moment.js. It supports human-readable relative and precise durations, calendar formatting, and multiple localizations.
use_when: You need to display relative time strings like '2 hours ago'.
You require robust localization support for dates and durations.
You want an immutable DateTime subclass with rich convenience methods.
avoid_when: You only need basic, unlocalized DateTime manipulation already built into standard Dart.
strengths: Rich set of formatting, calendar, and duration methods.
Supports multiple localizations out of the box.
Immutable design prevents accidental state mutation.
weaknesses: Adds an external dependency and API surface for functionality partially covered by Dart core.
